name: checklist-reveal
title: Checklist Reveal
description: Turn a practical checklist into a satisfying sequence.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: AI may rewrite the title, supporting note, and up to four checklist rows. Keep pipe separators between items and preserve the steps layout.

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses authored timings; this is not word alignment.

useWhen: Show a short set of observable checks or practical tasks.
avoidWhen: Do not mark an unverified task complete, or present causal dependencies as independent checks.

inputRules.title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.items: Supply 1–4 entries separated by "|", each with exactly 2 nonempty fields separated by "::". Keep each field within 64 characters.
inputRules.highlight: Use a real in-range integer; a focus index must point to an existing item.
inputRules.note: Supply real supporting note within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

readingOrder: Read each check and its evidence

cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches items 1, reveal this check and its evidence. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-2: When narration reaches items 2, reveal this check and its evidence. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-3: When narration reaches items 3, reveal this check and its evidence. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.step-4: When narration reaches items 4, reveal this check and its evidence. Do not infer a word timestamp from character count.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults or custom graphics under recipes-only policy.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

values.title: 开课前，先确认这些条件
values.items: 场地::教室与照明可用|课程::内容经过审核|报名::人数已经确认|安全::退出路线清楚
values.note: 这是检查清单，不代表检查已经完成

example.narration: 开课前先确认场地和照明，再核对课程、报名人数和退出路线。

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Name the checklist → Read each check and its evidence → Review the complete list. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
usage.intent: 逐项呈现可执行的检查动作，让观众最后得到一张可复核的清单。
